newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.09 percent higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session 0.09 percent higher.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse index ended session higher, but trading on the market remained flat ahead of rumours on a new floatings, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index rose 0.09 percent to close at 400.81 points. The main gain was registered by BRANOMA firm, a subsidiary of brewery Brasseries du Maroc. It rose 55 dirhams to close at 865 dirhams.

Centrale Laitiere, a subsidiary of Morocco's largest private ONA Group, closed at 1,380 dirhams, up 30 dirhams on the previous session. The bourse turnover rose slightly to 8.3 million dirhams, up from 7.5 million dirhams on Tuesday. ($1= 8.6 dirhams)
